description: This file contains utility functions for VSCode configuration management, including determining the product directory name, locating user data directories, reading JSON5 configuration files, and handling profile file enumeration.

methods.name: productDirName
methods.description: Determines the product directory name based on the VSCode environment app name.

methods.name: getUserDataBaseDir
methods.description: Returns the path to the user data directory based on environment variables and platform.

methods.name: readJSON5File
methods.description: Reads and parses a JSON5 file asynchronously, returning null on failure.

methods.name: canReadLocalFiles
methods.description: Checks if local files can be read based on VSCode environment variables.

methods.name: readUserConfigFile
methods.description: Reads user configuration files, searching in candidate locations, and returns an array of rules.
